description_expanded: **Must be at least 25 years of age to rent this property. 25 E Milestone Drive #C at Prominence on 30a! 6 Seat LSV Included! Tropical Pool a few steps away. Walk to restaurants and entertainment. We give this beach property 5 stars! This is perhaps the most beautiful townhouse in Prominence, the newest beach community on 30a. The 2nd floor unit is designed with comfortable elegance in mind, our two bedroom, two bathroom townhouse is perfectly located just steps from the tropical swimming pool. For a truly memorable beach vacation, treat yourself to a respite at this delightfully convenient and professionally designed beach town house. "Gracefully stylish" describes the decor with soft, understated colors of the sea and hardwood floors throughout. Our living area is designed with 10 foot ceilings, and is furnished with generous comfy seating, a large HDTV, and access to a walk-out balcony through french doors. The dining table seats 4-5 guests, and there is additional bar seating for 3-4. The chef in your group will be delighted with our gourmet style kitchen which offers the newest stainless appliances, including a 5 burner gas stove. The luxurious master bedroom features a king bed, HDTV and a walk-in closet. Just a step away is the spa-like master bathroom with a double vanity and an oversized shower. The bunk room is handsomely furnished with two double beds and a twin trundle. For unexpected guests, there is a queen sleeper sofa in the living area. For your convenience, the laundry room features a full size washer and dryer. *Please note: there is parking only for one car. Beach Access: Take the LSV and spin on over to the sugar white sand. For guests who prefer to walk or ride a bicycle to the beach, there is a sidewalk path. Strollers and wagons are welcome on the boardwalk, and guests may bring their own umbrellas and beach chairs. Closest beach access is less than 1 mile from this unit. The Town of Prominence is located on Highway 30a between Seagrove and Alys Beach. Guests enjoy easy access to a beautiful Town Center and a resort style pool. The state of the art swimming complex offers a tropical style swimming pool, hammocks, an outdoor dining area, and two gas grills for guest's use. ''The Chill30a” is the community's town center and features restaurants, shops, and an amphitheater with a covered event pavilion, a cinema screen for movies as well as a stage for concerts and events. We invite you to discover the magic of 30a at 25C Prominence! From HOA: *Prominence neighborhood restrictions begin at 9 PM for age 18 & under; minors must be accompanied by an adult while on Prominence property during times when curfew is active. The 2026 Curfew Dates are Established as: March 7th thru April 5th July 3rd thru July 6th September 4th thru September 7th October 9th thru October 18th CANCELLATION: Reservations that are cancelled more than 30 days prior to the arrival date receive a full refund. Reservations cancelled 14-29 days prior to arrival receive a refund of 50% of the amount paid. Reservations cancelled within 14 days of arrival receive no refund unless the guest purchased travel insurance. Guests are required to complete a rental agreement by electronic signature within 3 days of booking. NOTE: The total reservation cost includes the nightly rate, clean fee, damage waiver, processing fee and tax. By requesting a quote for this property, you agree to be added to our email subscription list.
